name: @directus/extensions
description: Utilities and types for Directus extensions
author: Rijk van Zanten <rijkvanzanten@me.com>
//sideEffects: None of the modules here do anything at import time. Without this an api extension bundling `defineHook` keeps every zod schema alive with it — 125 KB for an identity function.

scripts.//build-no-clean: build:node and build:shared both emit into dist/. When pnpm runs them sequentially (e.g. workspace-concurrency=1), the second tsdown cleans the first's output (index.js/node.js) before writing its own. --no-clean disables that step so both sets of outputs coexist.
scripts.//build-unbundle: The shared entry ships to extension bundlers. Emitting one module per source file is what lets them drop the zod-backed schemas when only the define* helpers are imported; a single bundled file keeps the two inseparable.
